'''Dr. Stae-Fahnti Koelbayr''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]], who worked as a commentator. He attended the launch of the luxury [[Hovertrain/Legends|repulsortrain]] ''[[Gem of Alderaan]]'', on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].

==Behind the scenes==
[[Gary M. Sarli]], an editor and developer for the [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]] and other related RPG guides, created Stae-Fahnti Koelbayr as a reference to comedian and talk show host [[Wikipedia:Stephen Colbert|Stephen Colbert]], using him in [[2009]]'s ''[[Dawn of Defiance]]'' campaign, ''[[The Gem of Alderaan]]''. In addition, the character possesses the title of D.F.A., the same that Colbert received as an honorary title.<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://plus.google.com/114289664433795631450/posts/Vba9AdjK8Up|text=Gary M. Sarli's Google Plus status|archivedate=20190330061353}}</ref>
